annotations.title: Request a model, feature or tool

description: Report a Hugging Bay bug (such as a broken download link) or ask for a feature, tool, integration or model; duplicates join the existing request and return its id. Use when reporting a bug or asking for a feature, tool or integration. Example: {"kind":"model","wanted":"Qwen/model","public":false}. Needs the user's OK for a public title (confirm_public true), or public false. No build promise.

confirm_public.description: True only after your user agrees that a short title may be public. Use public false otherwise.

example.description: Optional example of the need; stored privately as data.

harness.description: Optional client or runner name; stored privately.

kind.description: Type of model, feature, tool, integration or bug request.

public.description: True permits a reviewed public title and requires confirm_public; false keeps only public counts.

wanted.description: Model owner/name or requested change; untrusted user data.

why.description: Why the user needs it; stored privately as data.

name: request_feature
